name: Syntys Kuwait City Data Center
developer: Syntys (Ooredoo spin-out; Iron Mountain minority JV)
notes: Iron Mountain names Syntys Kuwait City (Capital). Directory address Al-Soor St/Ooredoo Tower is C-grade. Ooredoo-hosted Syntys deck: Kuwait 2 active DCs, ~2.2 MW active IT load / 2 MW current capacity at country level (do not allocate per site).

name: Ooredoo Kuwait sovereign AI-enabled data center
notes: Launched at Al-Jarida MoneyTech Summit (Nov 2025); NVIDIA H200 GPUs, sovereign AI DC. Site undisclosed, likely within Syntys/Ooredoo Kuwait footprint (Capital). B for launch press; A only for Ooredoo regional NVIDIA plan. Division Capital provisional.

name: Zain Business Data Center (ZBDC)
notes: ZBDC services confirmed via CBK MoU (data storage, security, connectivity) and Zain sources (A/B service existence). Facility address/specs C; likely Capital (Kuwait City).

name: Zain Kuwait HQ1 Data Center
notes: Uptime Institute tier-achievement entry names Zain Kuwait HQ1 (A for certification existence); may underpin ZBDC services. Division Capital assumed (Zain HQ); tier level detail not confirmed on page.

name: stc Kuwait Data Center 1 & Data Center 2
notes: stc 2024 sustainability report names Data Center 1 and Data Center 2 in critical-location assessments (A for existence). No address/capacity; Capital likely. Public-facing commercial address leads are C.

name: Zajil / Kalaam Kuwait data center (KEMS Zajil)
notes: DCD names the Kuwait data center, single-story built to Tier III standards (design claim, not Uptime cert). Kalaam acquired Zajil (now KEMS Zajil). Capital likely.

name: Microsoft AI-powered Azure Region (intent)
notes: Intent-level partnership 2025-03-06 (Microsoft/CAIT/CITRA); no site/timeline; Azure regions list has no Kuwait entry as of check — planned_or_mou only.

name: Google Cloud Kuwait region (intent)
developer: Google Cloud (with Government of Kuwait / Alshaya)
notes: 2023-01 agreement; no timeline/location; Google locations list has no Kuwait entry as of check — planned_or_mou. Division undisclosed; Capital provisional.

name: ix.kw Internet Exchange (TEC Building)
notes: connectivity_only: carrier-neutral IXP announced by CITRA 2019-10-20, contact at TEC Building; no colocation evidence — not counted as datacenter.

name: Submarine cable landings (FALCON/FOG/GBI/Kuwait-Iran, MEETS/EIG)
notes: connectivity_only: cable landing leads at Kuwait City; network adjacency only, no data-center service evidence.

name: Syntys Shuaiba Data Center
notes: Iron Mountain names Shuaiba (Ahmadi governorate) as a Syntys location; strongest non-Capital public-colo lead. No per-site MW sourced.

name: Omniva/Moneta Sea City GPU & crypto data center plan (Al Khiran)
notes: Historical 2022 plan at Sea City/Al Khiran (Ahmadi); not active supply per DCD analysis; keep separate from public colo.
